title: Contacts: allow identical server-set values, {} no-op
description: Mirror the mail template to jmap-contacts-server card.rs:273, addressbook.rs:388. Mark's decision (on JMAP-t8ej.25 notes): an empty patch {} — literal, or empty after dropping identical server-set values — SUCCEEDS as a no-op: updated {id: null}, no write, state unchanged. RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. One test per handler.
